title: Discovery of novel 4-aminobenzamide derivatives as small molecule CBX2 inhibitors.
authors: Kawamoto, Yuichiro; Takase, Shohei; Ashutosh, Kumar; Maruo, Hiroki; Maemoto, Yuki; Zhang, Kam Y J; Ito, Hisanaka; Ito, Akihiro
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CBX2蛋白的小分子抑制剂发现，属于表观遗传调控中的蛋白-甲基赖氨酸识别，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: CBX2 protein plays an important role in methyl-lysine recognition involved in epigenetic regulation. In contrast to CBX7 modulators, there are few reported CBX2 inhibitors, most of which are peptidergic molecules. This fact encouraged us to search non-peptidic small molecule CBX2 inhibitors with sufficient cell permeability by in silico screening followed by synthetic evolution. In virtual screening, we identified a 4-aminobenzamide scaffold with high in silico score and Nano BRET activities. Based on several in silico hit compounds, we synthesized a series of 4-aminobenzamide derivatives and tested their Nano BRET activities. Among them, compound 37 showed moderate CBX2 inhibitory activity with an IC(50) value of 9.6 muM, a potential lead compound. This is a first small molecule CBX2 inhibitor identified as a result of SAR studies and lead optimization by medicinal chemistry.
abstract_zh: CBX2蛋白在甲基赖氨酸识别中发挥重要作用，参与表观遗传调控。与CBX7调节剂相比，已报道的CBX2抑制剂较少，且大多数为肽类分子。这一事实促使我们通过计算机筛选及随后的合成演化，寻找具有足够细胞通透性的非肽类小分子CBX2抑制剂。在虚拟筛选中，我们识别出一个具有高计算机评分和Nano BRET活性的4-氨基苯甲酰胺骨架。基于若干计算机命中化合物，我们合成了一系列4-氨基苯甲酰胺衍生物，并测试了其Nano BRET活性。其中，化合物37显示出中等的CBX2抑制活性，IC(50)值为9.6 μM，是一个潜在的先导化合物。这是首个通过构效关系研究和药物化学先导优化识别出的小分子CBX2抑制剂。
